spec.name: Taza Heritage Music Festival
spec.description: Festival in Taza dedicated to preserving Moroccan traditional musical heritage, programming Andalusian art, Malhun and Gharnati ensembles from across the country alongside a permanent heritage exhibition and an artistic competition.

editions.notes: Held at Taza Al-Olia Theater; organized by the Regional Directorate of the Ministry of Youth, Culture and Communication (Culture Department) in Taza with the Zaydan Association for Andalusian Song and Authentic Art
